text:
olivia: quick sync — i'm implementing per-route quota headers for the new billing PR. want to confirm contract for 429 responses when a route uses burst credits.

sam: quick q — do we include both global and per-route headers every time? example clients expect X-RateLimit-Remaining today.

diego: my preference is to surface per-route headers by default. include global headers only when the global limiter is the blocking factor so clients can choose which signal to trust.

maya: backwards-compat concern: older SDKs read X-RateLimit-Remaining and assume it's global. we should send a fallback X-RateLimit-Remaining when per-route is present to avoid silent breakage.

olivia: proposed header contract (minimal):

```
X-RateLimit-PerRoute-Limit: 100
X-RateLimit-PerRoute-Remaining: 20
X-RateLimit-PerRoute-Reset: 1680000000
X-RateLimit-Global-Remaining: 500   # optional, only if global limiter is relevant
Retry-After: 12                       # for 429 responses
```

And 429 response body (machine-readable):

```
{
  "code": "rate_limit",
  "scope": "per-route",         // "global" when global limiter
  "retry_after": 12,            // seconds
  "info": "optional human message"
}
```

sam: small nit — our error JSON currently uses snake_case in most places (e.g., retry_after). keep snake_case for consistency.

diego: question about burst exposure: do we want to surface how many burst tokens remain? i can see clients making different decisions if they know there's a short burst left. maybe a header like X-RateLimit-PerRoute-Burst-Remaining: 5

maya: prefer not to leak internal bucket identifiers or policies. if we include burst tokens, keep it numeric only (no bucket names). privacy/compliance flagged internal names before.

olivia: agreed — numeric-only. also important: when we set per-route headers, servers MUST also set X-RateLimit-Remaining for compatibility (same value as PerRoute-Remaining) for at least one release cycle, then we can deprecate. we'll document deprecation in the SDK changelog.

deploy-bot: [deploy] feature/rl-headers staged to prod-perf at 2004510000 :rocket:

olivia: action items:
- sam: add header examples and 429 body schema to the OpenAPI and docs (owner: @sam)
- diego: implement server-side fallback to set X-RateLimit-Remaining when per-route headers present; add unit + integration tests for burst cases (owner: @diego)
- maya: run partner compatibility smoke tests and confirm no SDK breakage; check telemetry for errors (owner: @maya)
- olivia: add parser tests for client-side handling of both header sets and the 429 body.

sam: on it, i'll open the docs PR today :thumbsup:

diego: i'll add tests and a short config flag to toggle the per-route header exposure for canary testing.

maya: will run partner tests tomorrow morning and report if anything fails.

olivia: thanks all. i'll follow up with a short note in the release checklist and tag the SDK leads for awareness. :eyes:
